messages.author: e715a3aeb27b07f3
messages.subject: Plotting region as png
parts:
Hello,

I try to export my plot as PNG. But I only need the plotting region -
no axis, no label, no legend, no extra space...
How can I do it?
So far, I tried the following (which still has some white space
remaining...):


testDF <- data.frame(x = LETTERS[1:3], y = "row1", value = rnorm(3))

png("temp.png", width = 30, height = 10)
p <- ggplot(testDF, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value))
p <- p + geom_tile() + scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0,0))
p <- p + scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0,0))
p <- p + coord_fixed()
p <- p + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + opts(legend.position = "none",
panel.background=theme_blank(), plot.margin = unit(rep(0, 4),
"lines"), axis.text.x = theme_blank(), axis.ticks = theme_blank())
p <- p + opts(axis.text.y = theme_blank())
print(p)
dev.off()


What else can I do?

Antje
